title: VDP Attenuable Capability Token
description: Wire format of a token: (S_0, [C_1 .. C_n], t_n), bound to policy_hash. SPEC.md section 5.5. Structural validity (this schema) is NOT the same as cryptographic validity — a well-formed token still requires HMAC chain verification against the root key (SPEC.md section 5.3).

tag.description: Hex-encoded HMAC-SHA256 output over policy_hash, the root scope, and the caveat chain (SPEC.md section 5.3).

policy_hash.description: SPEC.md section 5.1a. "" (default/legacy, vdp-spec-0.2): unbound -- verifies under any policy sharing the root key. A non-empty value binds this ROOT token's tag to that specific policy artifact's policy_hash; tampering with this field invalidates the tag, same as any other forgery attempt.

scope.title: Scope
scope.description: A point in the meet-semilattice (SPEC.md section 5.1). null means TOP ('constrains nothing'), the identity for meet.

verbs.description: Finite verb set, or null for TOP (unrestricted). A root scope MUST NOT leave both verbs and targets at TOP.

max_amount.description: Per-action amount ceiling, minor units, or null for unbounded.

max_total.description: Cumulative ceiling for this token specifically (distinct from the monitor's own counter). A root token MUST leave this at null/TOP.

expires_at.description: Unix epoch second, or null for never. No formatted date strings.
